text:
[LTAC.5.1] The follow-up rule's LHS re-evaluates on every clock
tick, and the engine takes one tick per pump ([IRET.19.5]): a timer's
follow-up fires on the first tick at or after `fire_at`. How soon after
`fire_at` that is depends on how often the integrator pumps
([LLOG.11.2]); the engine has no tick interval of its own.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__born
idris.note: The follow-up's activation is made by the tick at or after `fire_at`. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__due_b
idris.note: The guard re-evaluated at every tick, as a function of the clock the tick sets.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__state
idris.note: The quiescent state between ticks. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__tick_literal
idris.note: The LHS re-evaluates on every tick: the activation is made by the tick whose sample reaches `fire_at`.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__ticked
idris.note: The state the first tick at or after `fire_at` leaves, before the firing. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__wm
idris.note: The timer live before the first tick at or after `fire_at`, gone after. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__after_ticks_is_state
idris.note: The state after a tick history is quiescent at the clock the ticks reached.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__one_shot_executed
idris.note: The tick at `fire_at` fires, the ticks after it do not. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__one_shot_is_an_instance
idris.note: THE THEOREM AT THE ONE-SHOT HISTORY: the counts over ticks 1 to 4 are the clause's, `[0, 1, 0, 0]` -- the due tick with ticks after it. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__independent_counts
idris.note: Each timer fires on the first tick at or after its own `fire_at`. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__inputs
idris.note: Ticks on and past both timers' `fire_at`. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__at_most_once_is_an_instance
idris.note: At most one tick fires the follow-up.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__clock_after
idris.note: The clock the ticks reach. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__clock_after_lte
idris.note: Ticks move the clock forward only.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__due_at_assert_fires_now
idris.note: A timer due at assert fires at that pump, no tick needed: the clause's lower bound on resolution is not a delay. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__due_edges
idris.note: The clause as a list: 1 at the first tick at or after `fire_at`, 0 at every other. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__due_edges_total
idris.note: One firing when the history reaches `fire_at`, none before.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__due_net
idris.note: The timer's activation at the first tick at or after `fire_at`. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__edges_after_due
idris.note: No tick after the first at or after `fire_at` fires the follow-up.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__edges_are_first_due
idris.note: The gate's edges are the clause's counts: the first tick at or after `fire_at`, and no other.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__fires_on_the_first_due_tick
idris.note: THE FOLLOW-UP FIRES ON THE FIRST TICK AT OR AFTER `fire_at`, AND ON NO OTHER: from the quiescent state at a clock below `fire_at`, over any tick history, the counts are 0 at every tick whose sample stays below `fire_at`, 1 at the first whose sample reaches it, 0 at every tick after. One timer; the counts are the gate's edges and the edges are the clause's.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__loaded_is_state
idris.note: The theorems' starting state is the loaded network with the timer asserted. Computed.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__ticked_run
idris.note: The run after a tick fires exactly when the tick reached `fire_at`.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__timer_counts_are_edges
idris.note: Every tick re-evaluates the LHS, and the firings over a history are the gate's edges.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__timer_pump
idris.note: One tick: the firing is the gate's edge, 1 at the tick whose sample reaches `fire_at`, 0 elsewhere.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__zeros
idris.note: The ticks on which the follow-up does not fire. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__zeros_total
idris.note: No firings after the firing.

idris.name: ltac_5_3__late_edge
idris.note: The tick whose sample reaches `fire_at` fires the follow-up, at or past.

idris.name: ltac_5_3__missed_tick_fires_late
idris.note: The first tick at or after `fire_at` is the one at 3, and it fires. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_5_3__missed_tick_is_an_instance
idris.note: The theorem at the missed tick. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_5_3__never_lost
idris.note: Over any history: one firing once the clock has reached `fire_at`.

idris.name: ltac_5_3__once_if
idris.note: The one firing, or none, the clause's count sums to. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_4__same_tick_counts
idris.note: Both fire on the first tick at or after their `fire_at`, which is the same tick. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__born_timed
idris.note: The follow-up's activation is made by the re-time whose sample reaches `fire_at`. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__state_timed
idris.note: The quiescent state between cycles. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__tick_literal_timed
idris.note: The LHS re-evaluates at the re-time: the activation is made by the sample that reaches `fire_at`.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__wm_timed
idris.note: The timer live before the first tick at or after `fire_at`, gone after. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__after_cycles_is_state_timed
idris.note: The state after a history is quiescent at the clock the ticks reached.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__one_shot_timed
idris.note: The pump whose sample reaches `fire_at` fires, the pump after it does not. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__independent_timed
idris.note: Each timer fires on the first tick at or after its own `fire_at`. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__after_timed
idris.note: The state after a tick history. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__at_most_once_timed
idris.note: At most one cycle fires the follow-up.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__born_run_timed
idris.note: THE RUN FROM THE RE-TIMED STATE, over the four readings of the gate: fires once when the re-time made the edge and takes the timer, fires nothing otherwise; the gate open before and shut after is no reading, the gate being rising.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__counts_timed
idris.note: The counts of a tick history: one per pump. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__cycle
idris.note: A CYCLE on the Idris model's engine: a tick, then a pump -- the re-time at the held sample over the stamps, then the gated stamped run. The cadence every temporal fixture drives. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__cycle_steps
idris.note: THE STEPS OF A TICK HISTORY as a fixture drives them: each tick then a pump under its fuel. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__cycles
idris.note: THE CYCLES OF A TICK HISTORY on the Idris model's engine: each tick followed by a pump, the state after, and the number of firings of each pump. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__cycles_are_the_steps
idris.note: THE CYCLES ARE THE STEPS: Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's run of a history's steps -- what the witnesses and the runner compute -- reaches the cycles' state, and its verdict lists are as long as the cycles' counts. By induction on the ticks, the pump's result and the recursive call's each matched to its tuple.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__cycles_cons
idris.note: One cycle of a history, unfolded: the cycles of the rest from the state the cycle left, with the cycle's count in front.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__due_timed
idris.note: THE DUE STATE: the timer live and its activation born unfired at the clock that reached `fire_at`. What the run consumes. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__fires_on_the_first_due_tick_timed
idris.note: THE FOLLOW-UP FIRES ON THE FIRST TICK AT OR AFTER `fire_at`, AND ON NO OTHER, on the Idris model's engine: from the quiescent state at a clock below the stamp plus the duration, over any tick history, the firings are Rete/NetworkAfter.idr's clause counts at that `fire_at` -- 0 at every tick whose sample stays below it, 1 at the first whose sample reaches it, 0 at every tick after. The counts are the `dwell` gate's edges, the `dwell` gate is the `fire_at` gate (the guard is the gate), and that gate's edges are the clause's.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__firings_if
idris.note: THE FIRINGS OF ONE EDGE: the follow-up's one firing of the timer, with the gate admitting, when the edge is made; none otherwise. A named function on the edge count, not an inline `if`. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__firings_if_length
idris.note: The firings of an edge are as many as the edge: an edge is 0 or 1. By cases on the gate's two readings.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__tick_literal_timed
idris.note: THE TICK ON THE QUIESCENT STATE moves the clock alone: no deadline, no row, so the sweep expires nothing and the cascade touches nothing; the wall, the stamps and the trackers stand.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__timer_counts_are_edges_timed
idris.note: THE COUNTS ARE THE EDGES on the Idris model's engine: over any tick history from any starting clock, the follow-up's firings per pump are the rising edges of the timer's `dwell` gate. Rete/NetworkEdges.idr's B2 for the timer chain, whose RHS retracts what it matched, on the engine the Idris model runs.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__timer_cycle
idris.note: ONE CYCLE OF ONE TIMER ON THE IDRIS MODEL'S ENGINE: from the quiescent state at a clock, a tick then a pump fire the gate's edge -- once, with the timer's retraction, when the sample reaches the stamp plus the duration; nothing otherwise -- and leave the quiescent state at the new clock, the wall, the stamps and the trackers standing. The tick is the clock's move alone; the re-time at entry is the re-time alone and makes the born activation; the run is one firing or none. Over every program, fuel, stamp, duration, clock, tick, payload and wall.

idris.name: ltac_5_3__never_lost_timed
idris.note: One firing exactly when some tick reaches `fire_at`: never before, never twice.

idris.name: ltac_9_1__nothing_before_the_delay_timed
idris.note: A tick whose sample stays below `fire_at` fires nothing. Executed.
